pages.text: Party up with your friends with $(bold)P$() (FTB Teams). Party members share boss XP and Gate XP.$(br2)Claim your base with $(bold)O$() (Open Parties and Claims): claim the chunks around it and add your party. Claimed chunks are safe from other players and from explosions.
$(bold)Voice chat$(): $(bold)\$() opens the voice menu, $(bold)-$() makes a group. Proximity voice is on by default.$(br2)$(bold)Ping Wheel$(): $(bold)Right Shift$() drops a marker your party sees.
